'''{{PAGENAME}}''' {{Lang|zh=椋羽}} is a quest-exclusive NPC that first appears with '''[[Jingming]]''' in {{Quest|The Wind Before the Storm}}. 

She appears again in {{Quest|Song of the Heart Sword}} with '''Xiangwu'''. 
__NOTOC__
{{Dialogue Start}}
==Idle==
:'''Qinyan:''' Ming...! You're hurt?!
:'''Jingming:''' Ugh, I'm fine... Just a scratch. Nothing serious, Yan...

==Dialogue==
;During {{Quest|The Wind Before the Storm}}
:'''Qinyan:''' Ming...! You're hurt?!

:'''Jingming:''' Ugh, I'm fine... Just a scratch. Nothing serious, Yan...

:'''Qinyan:''' What happened?! You said you were just patrolling the Censure Courts. How could this happen...?

:'''Jingming:''' Those Autopuppets... they went crazy out of nowhere. We didn't even have time to react...

:'''Jingming:''' I was one of the lucky ones. [[Liangyu]] got us out. But so many of our people... They...
----
;During {{Quest|Song of the Heart Sword}}
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 91 1.ogg}} '''Qinyan:''' So beautiful... First time seeing Paragon Qingxiao with my own eyes.

:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 91 2.ogg}} '''Qinyan:''' Grandfather and Grandmother were right. She looks exactly like the Sword Transcendent in the paintings.

:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 92 3.ogg}} '''Xiangwu:''' That's not the half of it. She's the master of the finest cultivation school in all the land.

:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 92 1.ogg}} '''Qinyan:''' Huh? What does the Paragon have to do with a cultivation school?

:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 92 2.ogg}} '''Xiangwu:''' Well, she is the master of the Xuanyuan School in the Eastern Xuan Peaks. The only Perfected One in all of Xuanfang. She has watched over this land for centuries.

:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 92 3.ogg}} '''Xiangwu:''' At the Martial Arts Championship a few years back, she was an honored guest. Many sect leaders even greeted her as their "Transcendent Elder."

:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 92 4.ogg}} :'''Xiangwu:''' Why, even the great Daoist Master Jiufeng, with all his profound knowledge, sent his favorite disciples to her for guidance.

:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 92 6.ogg}} '''Qinyan:''' All I know is Paragon Qingxiao has been around since my great-great-grandmother's time.

:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 92 7.ogg}} '''Qinyan:''' But I've never heard of this Xuanyuan School... You didn't make that up, did you?
{{Dialogue End}}
